Subject: Pilot request: acceptance criteria & onboarding flow

Hi Evelyn + team,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the latency profile you showed looks promising for our agent routing use case. We are preparing an internal 30-day pilot and want to lock an acceptance playbook so we know what success looks like.

Can you send a MAP/template that includes:
- proposed acceptance criteria (latency p95, quality checks, allowed error rates)
- required integrations (VPC, logging, API keys)
- sample timeline for a 30-day pilot with key milestones and stakeholder owners

Our stakeholders: me (product), Maya Desai (eng lead), and Procurement (copied below). Goal is to start the pilot the week of Nov 15.

Are you able to share a starter doc and a 30-day timeline slide? Also curious about cadence for weekly checkpoints and a short tech readiness checklist.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Turner
Product Manager, Pegasus AI

Alex — looping in a lightweight draft of the 30d timeline and a proposed weekly checkpoint cadence. See summary below and attached slide stub (Pegasus_30d-pilot-timeline.gslides).

Summary (draft):
Week 0 (prep): access + baseline test set delivered by Pegasus; Redwood provides onboarding runbook.
Week 1 (integration): API connectivity, KV/cache validation, initial short-run evals.
Week 2 (scale & eval): load tests at target QPS, quality evals against prompts, tweak batching/quant.
Week 3 (acceptance): joint acceptance run (72h), capture regressions, finalize handoff docs.
Weekly checkpoints (30m): Monday sync with engineering + product; Friday async summary with actions.

Notes: I left placeholders for acceptance thresholds — happy to set example p95 targets if you share baseline numbers.

Alex / Maya / Procurement — attaching the consolidated MAP/acceptance playbook and a compact 30-day slide. This is a first draft; I highlighted required artifacts and who owns each item.

Draft highlights: 
- Acceptance run definition: 72-hour joint run at target QPS with no >5% functional regressions on the golden prompt set.
- Safety & data handling: logs forwarded to Pegasus S3 bucket for 90 days; audit hooks enabled.
- Rollback/fallback: automatic fallback to smaller model variant on sustained latency breaches above 110% of SLA.

Next steps:
1) Procurement: confirm PO cadence and any draft SoW requests (Alex/Procurement)
2) Maya: confirm access owner and schedule week 0 prep call (proposed Nov 12)
3) Redwood: finalize MAP by Nov 9 end-of-day if we get baseline latencies from Pegasus (Alex)

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_template_v1.gdoc (updated), Pegasus_30d-pilot-timeline.gslides

Best,
Jonas Weber
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
